title: Figure 45: TAV vs. B-52 annual operational cost comparison drawings (MDC study, 1984)
description: Two drawings: a shaded launch vehicle stack (TAV) at left and a perspective drawing of a B-52 bomber at right. Cost annotations read "Cost $97,000,000 Atmospheric Cruise / $251,000,000 Orbital" and "Cost $71,000,000 B-52 only* / $140,000,000 Refueled B-52," with "*annual costs per DAA (14 vehicles)" and attribution "Larry Fogel, Decision Sciences, Titan Corporation, Spring 1984." Caption: "Figure 45. McDonnell Douglas Astronautics (Huntington Beach)-Funded Study of TAV Operational Costs"; appears in "Appendix C: TAV Operational Costs."
